name: list_tables
description: Lists the tables of one database on a ClickHouse service by querying system.tables and system.columns as the authenticated identity, optionally narrowed with the like and notLike name patterns. Each table includes its engine and full engine definition, CREATE TABLE statement, sorting and primary keys, view dependencies, row, byte, part, and mark counts, comment, and its columns with type, default kind and expression, and comment. Returns an empty array when nothing matches. If the query fails or the user lacks passwordless access to the service, result is an error object instead. Idle services are woken automatically and the call returns an error asking you to retry shortly; stopped services are never started automatically and must be started manually.

database.description: Database whose tables to list, for example a name returned by list_databases.

like.description: Optional SQL LIKE pattern to filter tables by name (e.g., "events_%")

notLike.description: Optional SQL LIKE pattern to exclude tables by name

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service that hosts the database. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
